hooks.name: supplaiguard-review-after-task
hooks.description: After each task completes (Stop), run the SupplAIGuard reviewer agent on a different model to independently cross-check the work. Fail-safe: never blocks or discards the completed task.

action.command: kiro-cli chat --agent supplaiguard-reviewer --no-interactive 'Review the changes from the task just completed against the SupplAIGuard spec and security policy. Use git diff to see what changed. Output your structured review.' 2>&1 || echo 'WARN: SupplAIGuard reviewer did not run (model unavailable or launch error); task work is preserved.'

confirm.question: Run the SupplAIGuard review agent (different model) on this task?
